label: derived
method: fitSystemDemand (packages/model/src/demand.ts): solves 31·a + b·ΣHDD_Jan = jan2024_total_bcf × 1,000 and a + b·HDD_record = record_day_mmcf.
assumptions: Record day = highest-HDD day 2024-01-30 to 2024-02-02 (AGENTS.md §13 D2): 2024-02-02, HDD 77. ADN reported the 268 MMcf record around midnight on Wed Jan 31, 2024 (HDD 73); using Jan 31 instead would imply about double the sourced annual demand.
Demand depends only on daily HDD; the 24-hour shape (demand_shape.json) is assumed and illustrative.

checks.annualNote: Implied annual = 365·a + b·hdd_annual; compare with annual_bcf (Enstar 2020 forecast).
